words.sentence: I'm worried about my test tomorrow.
words.def: You feel this when you think something bad might happen.

words.sentence: We're going to the zoo tomorrow. I'm so excited!
words.def: You feel this when something fun is going to happen soon.

words.sentence: My little brother is afraid of the dark.
words.def: You feel this when you think something will hurt you.

words.sentence: She was upset because she lost her toy.
words.def: You feel sad and unhappy, and you might cry.
